name: Itsuki Eimi
source:
“I don’t want to lose to myself again and again. So, I will only move forward as you said”

Eimi is 1st high school student who has cheerful personality. She often jokes and likes to tease Takagi because of his too strict personality. Her goal is to become real athlete in Basketball club even if her body is so short that make disadvantages in her favorite sport.

She is joyful and determined girl who love basketball but she always hides her sadness behind her smile. Because of her kind personality, she decides to be friend with Takagi who is the lonely person and often come to Art club room to meet him and makes him smile.
